name: Bhutan
about: Spring (Mar–May) and autumn (Sep–Nov) are best for clear mountain views and trekking; monsoon (Jun–Aug) brings heavy rain, and winter is cold but clear at lower elevations.
overview: The last Buddhist kingdom of the Himalayas — cliffside monasteries, masked-dance festivals, and tourism deliberately built around Gross National Happiness.
costOverview: Bhutan is expensive from day one — a mandatory $100/day Sustainable Development Fee applies to every visit, before anything else.

specialSeasons.text: Black-necked cranes winter in the Phobjikha Valley — one of Bhutan's most distinctive wildlife spectacles.
